checks.name: Invitation roundtrip, version, expiry and address validation
View snapshot roundtrip preserves scores and excludes icon paths
Actual IPv4 TCP TLS join and seat reservation
Wrong bearer secret cannot occupy the room
Both ready before a shot; wrong player and duplicates rejected
Non-finite and out-of-range shots rejected without state changes
Host physics determines both views and free-ball turn
Pause and restart require both seats
Socket loss resumes the reserved seat and never replays a shot
LAN discovery reveals no bearer secret and requires host approval
Rejected discovered join does not reserve a seat
IPv6 loopback uses the same invitation and TLS protocol
All four rule presets negotiate their fixed ball counts
Closing the host notifies the guest and releases its port
Oversized framed message rejected before allocation
Reconnect grace timeout ends rather than inventing a winner
Obsolete board revision cannot place a free ball
